prompt: According to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), which country had the highest number of mobile cellular subscribers (per 100 people) worldwide in 1990?
answer: Sweden had the highest mobile cellular subscription rate in 1990, at approximately **5.4 subscribers per 100 people**.
